api: No OpenFEC request is made. No API key is read.
individual_contributions: indiv* files are not downloaded or parsed.

candidate_summary_files.reason: The current-campaigns file and the all-candidates file are one row per candidate, have no committee id, and the FEC description says a candidate with more than one authorized committee is combined and can double-count transfers between those committees. Candidate names and election-result columns are not read.

memo_code: Rows with memo code X are excluded from edge amounts. The FEC field description says that code is not incorporated into the total on the summary page.
pas2: The contributions-to-candidates file is a subset of the any-transaction file. Both files are read. A pas2 row whose SUB_ID was already aggregated from the any-transaction file is not added again.
privacy: Entity types IND and CAN are summed into the individuals residual bucket and the payee name is not stored. A blank, unrecognized, or conflicting entity type is summed into the other residual bucket and the name is not stored. Street, city, ZIP, employer, occupation, memo text, treasurer, and candidate id are not stored.

sizes.note: Projected bytes are the JSON size, with the same indent as the pilot shards, of one top-payee shard for every PAC and party committee whose itemized non-memo disbursements fit under the official total and that reported a non-zero total or a non-zero itemized sum. The gzip figure uses Python gzip compresslevel 6 on those same bytes. Candidate-campaign committees are not in the projection.
